_note: R-PROGRESSION-BETA PB-03. the Strikes a student can put in the Strike slot. Spin Kick is the default (nothing equipped) and copies today's Strike in config.ts COMBAT.strike exactly; a test keeps them equal. combo = the kick combo number whose teacher sign-off unlocks the Strike (Spin Kick has none: everyone has it). Every Strike costs 30 Focus (Strike cost never goes below 10). hits = the Strike's hits in order. strength is a share of Power like COMBAT.strike.strength; delayTicks counts from the button press (20 ticks = 1 second). reach, lungeTiles and recoveryTicks are as in COMBAT.strike. legacyIds = the old Strike ids (the abilities.json 'strikes' list, which is kept one release as the migration source) that now mean this Strike. Old strikes[n] was the kick combo n+1 unlock, so the mapping is by combo number: follow-up-kick (combo 1) -> spin-kick, quick-combo (combo 2) -> jumping-spins. Jumping Spins and Butterfly Flow numbers are PLACEHOLDERS until PB-09 (balance run). Rules from the redesign: all three Jumping Spins hits together beat Spin Kick's one hit, and the first is lighter than Spin Kick's; Butterfly Flow hits harder than Spin Kick and lands later.

strikes.name: Jumping Spin Kicks
strikes.text: Jump and spin three times. Each spin hits harder than the one before.

strikes.name: Butterfly Kick
strikes.text: Spin the other way. It takes a moment to land, but it hits harder.
